preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: s consists only of lowercase Latin letters and question marks

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: t consists only of lowercase Latin letters
length of s is between 1 and 10^5
length of t is between 1 and 10^5
product of lengths of s and t does not exceed 10^7

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == max(sum(1 for i in range(len(s) - len(t) + 1) if s[i:i+len(t)] == t) for s in possible_strings(s))
postconditions.description: output is the maximum number of occurrences of t in any possible string obtained by replacing question marks in s with lowercase Latin letters
